native.bitrate: Low nominal 12500 is proposed, not actual tolerance minimum 12000. Only the separate low/high ranges are valid; mode and waveform dependencies checked.
native.payload_bytes: Complete encoded 32-bit word, including label/parity, not four application bytes. Encoding/ICD remains unverified.
native.queue_policy: Abstract single-transmitter NIS queue; no native TAS/CBS or verified periodic word schedule.
native.arinc429_speed_mode: One low or high mode on a simplex channel; proposed LOW is not actual-link confirmation.
native.arinc429_gap_bit_times: At least four NULL bit times between words; chosen gap and rates still require actual schedule evidence.
native.arinc429_direction: One channel is simplex. Return traffic needs another independent channel.
native.arinc429_parity: Odd parity bit, error detection without built-in correction; actual encoding is not implemented by an identity codec.
native.arinc429_label: Eight-bit identifier, entered as decimal 0..255; literature labels are conventionally octal. Assignment comes from ICD, no default label.
native.arinc429_sdi: Optional two-bit SDI, no LRU address invention. If used, it reduces the available data bits by two.
native.arinc429_ssm: Two-bit SSM code; its meaning depends on BNR/BCD/discrete format, so no generic normal-state default. If used, reduces data bits by two.
native.arinc429_data_bits: Up to 23 bits after mandatory label/parity; at most 21 with SDI or SSM and 19 with both. BNR sign/resolution requires actual ICD.
native.arinc429_receiver_count: Actual 1..20 receiving sinks per channel; no invented number of configured receivers.
native.arinc429_transmitter_node_id: Actual single transmitting hardware identity, not inferred from an equipment name.
native.arinc429_rise_time_us: Actual rise time: LOW 5..15 microseconds, HIGH 1..2. Unknown device value; rate and mode constraints both apply.
native.arinc429_fall_time_us: Actual fall time: LOW 5..15 microseconds, HIGH 1..2. Unknown device value; rate and mode constraints both apply.

removed.qos_priority: Ethernet PCP is not an ARINC word priority; label is an identifier, not CAN arbitration.
removed.sync_method: NTP/PTP/gPTP are not native ARINC channel timing.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: An unbound percentage is not a per-label transmission schedule.
removed.retransmission_enabled: Native simplex words have no acknowledgement/retry. Part-3 file-transfer handshakes need two explicitly modeled channels.
removed.retransmission_rate: No generic native retry guarantee on a simplex channel.
removed.retry_limit: No generic native retry count on a simplex channel.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No generic native retry delay on a simplex channel.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: Generic 100 Mbit gateway capability is not actual ARINC hardware evidence.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: Actual gateway storage unknown; do not certify generic 256-word buffer.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: Actual gateway storage unknown; do not certify generic 256-word buffer.
removed.packet_loss_probability: ARINC carries words, not IP packets; explicit word/frame error injection remains a NIS scenario.
removed.duplicate_probability: Generic duplicate injection is not a native ARINC mechanism in this word model.
removed.reordering_probability: A single channel preserves its transmitted word order; no native packet-reorder control.

revisions: AIM ARINC 429 Tutorial v2.2 July 2019, pages 7-16; manufacturer reference, not latest licensed ARINC certification
scope: Each original and added parameter, nominal/tolerance modes, waveform/word dependencies, SQL storage, scoped native parameter preservation through standalone API

validation.scope: Every field type/options/bounds; disconnected rate ranges, waveform by rate and mode, word-field widths, failed SQL edits preserving state, native inputs reaching generated config

not_certified: Actual ICD, encoding and assigned devices
Electrical realization, receiver loading and cable constraints
Executable ARINC capacity/schedule model and E2E acceptance
Conformance to latest complete licensed ARINC specification
